content_sections.heading: ICMR Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the ICMR Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download ICMR Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Consultant (Scientific-Medical): MBBS, BDS, BVSc with At least 12 years of post-qualification experience Consultant (Scientific-Non Medical): M.Sc, MPH with At least 12 years of post-qualification experience in relevant subjects like nutrition, public health, epidemiology, health science etc

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Consultant (Scientific-Medical / Non-Medical): Minimum Age: 40 years, Maximum Age: 70 years

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Written test (consisting of 50 Multiple Choice Questions) if more than 30 candidates apply for each post Personal interview For retired personnel, only an interview shall be conducted

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the ICMR Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 19-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of ICMR to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) for filling consultant positions on a temporary contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in ICMR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Consultant (Scientific-Medical / Non-Medical) posts under advertisement number 5/9/7/Misc(staff)/2026-Nut.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form is 19-10-2026. Candidates must ensure they complete their submissions before this deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for Consultant posts?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for medical posts need MBBS, BDS, or BVSc, while non-medical posts require M.Sc or MPH, along with 12 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for ICMR Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 40 years, and the maximum age limit for applicants is 70 years for both medical and non-medical consultant roles.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for these consultant positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary ranging between ₹1,00,000 and ₹1,50,000/- per month based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q7. How can eligible candidates apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by filling out the details in the provided google form link and attaching all necessary self-attested documents.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for ICMR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned or required in the official notification for submitting the application form for these consultant roles.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for ICMR Consultants?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a written test (if applicants exceed 30 per post) and a personal interview. For retired personnel, only an interview is conducted.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online links?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification PDF, application links, and website details directly in the Important Links section of this recruitment article.
